---
title: "Interactive Dashboard"
format: html
server: shiny
---

```{r}
#| label: Install and Load Libraries
#| echo: false
#| message: true
#| warning: true

if(!require("shiny"))
  install.packages("shiny")
  library(shiny)

if(!require("DT"))
  install.packages("DT")
  library(DT)

if(!require("DBI"))
  install.packages("DBI")
  library(DBI)

if(!require("RSQLite"))
  install.packages("RSQLite")
  library(RSQLite)

if(!require("ggplot2"))
  install.packages("ggplot2")
  library(ggplot2)

if(!require("plotly"))
  install.packages("plotly")
  library(plotly)

if(!require("dplyr"))
  install.packages("dplyr")
  library(dplyr)

if(!require("dplyr"))
  install.packages("bslib")
  library(bslib)

conn <- dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), "virtual_production.db")
dbListTables(conn)

crew_list <- dbGetQuery(conn, "SELECT DISTINCT Name FROM CrewMembers")

budget_info <- dbGetQuery(conn, "SELECT MIN(Budget) AS min_budget, MAX(Budget) AS max_budget FROM Productions")

date_info <- dbGetQuery(conn, "SELECT MIN(DATE(EndDate)) AS min_date, MAX(DATE(EndDate)) AS max_date FROM Productions")

ui <- fluidPage(
  theme = bs_theme(
    version = 5,
    bootswatch = "flatly", 
    base_font = font_google("Roboto"), 
    heading_font = "Montserrat", 
    primary="#007bff"),
  
  titlePanel("Virtual Production Dashboard"),
  
  tabsetPanel(
    tabPanel("Data View",
             icon = icon("table"),
      h4("Explore Database Tables"),
      selectInput(
          inputId = "table_select", 
          label = "Select a Table to View:",
          choices = c("Clients", "Productions", "CrewMembers", "Assets"),
          selected = "Clients"
          ),
      DTOutput("table_output")
      ),
  
    tabPanel("Plot View 1",
             icon = icon("chart-line"),
      h4("Interactive Visualisations"),
      
      sidebarLayout(
        sidebarPanel(
          width = 3,
          style = "padding:20px; border-radius:10px;",
      selectInput(
        inputId = "crew_select", 
        label = "Select Crew Member:",
        choices = crew_list$Name,
        selected = crew_list$Name[1]
        ),
      
      dateRangeInput(
        inputId = "date_range",
        label = "Completion Date Range:",
        start="2023-01-01", end = Sys.Date()
        )
        ),
      
      mainPanel(
        width = 9,
        plotlyOutput("crew_plot", height="400px"),
      )
    )
),
      
     tabPanel("Plot View 2",
             icon = icon("chart-line"),
      h4("Production Budget & Status"),
      
      sidebarLayout(
        sidebarPanel(
          width = 3,
          style = "padding:20px; border-radius:10px;",
        sliderInput(
          inputId = "budget_range",
          label = "Budget Range:",
          min = 0, max = 1000000,
          value = c(0, 1000000),
          step = 10000,
        ),
      
        checkboxGroupInput(
          inputId = "status_filter", 
          label = "Production Status:",
          choices = c("Completed", "In-Progress"),
          selected = c("Completed", "In-Progress"),
          inline = TRUE
          )
        ),
        
        mainPanel(
          width = 9,
          plotlyOutput("budget_plot", height ="500px")
          )
        )
     )
  )
)

server <- function(input, output, session){
  
  output$table_output <- renderDT({
    req(input$table_select)
    df <- dbReadTable(conn, input$table_select)
    
    datatable(df, options = list(pageLength = 10, scrollX = TRUE))
  })
  

#---Plot 1 Crew Members and Productions ---
  
output$crew_plot <- renderPlotly({
  
  req(input$crew_select, input$date_range)
  
  query <- sprintf(
    "SELECT 
    p.Title, 
    p.EndDate, 
    p.Budget
    FROM Productions p
    JOIN ProductionCrew pc ON p.ProductionID = pc.ProductionID
    JOIN CrewMembers c ON pc.CrewID = c.CrewID
    WHERE c.Name = '%s'
    ORDER BY p.EndDate ASC", 
    
    input$crew_select, 
    input$date_range[1], 
    input$date_range[2])
  
  df <-dbGetQuery(conn, query)
 
  
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = EndDate, y = Budget, text = Title)) +
      geom_point(color = "#007bff", size = 3) + 
      labs(title = paste("Productions for", input$crew_select), 
           x = "Completion Date", y = "Budget") +
      theme_minimal()
  
  ggplotly(p, tooltip = c("text", "x", "y"))
  
})

#---Plot 2 Budget and Status---
  
output$budget_plot <- renderPlotly({
  req(input$budget_range, input$status_filter)
  
  query <- sprintf(
    "SELECT 
    p.Title, 
    p.Budget, 
    p.Status, 
    COUNT(pc.CrewID) AS CrewSize 
    FROM Productions p
    LEFT JOIN ProductionCrew pc ON p.ProductionID = pc.ProductionID 
    WHERE p.Budget BETWEEN 0 AND 999999999 AND p.Status IN ('Completed', 'In Progress')
    GROUP BY p.Title, p.Budget, p.Status
    ORDER BY p.Budget ASC",
    
  input$budget_range[1], 
  input$budget_range[2], 
  paste(input$status_filter, collapse = "','"))
  
  print(query)
  df <-dbGetQuery(conn, query)
  print(head(df))
  

    p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = CrewSize, y = Budget, colour = Status, text = Title)) +
      geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.7) + 
      labs(title = "Budget vs Crew Size by Status",
           x = "Crew Size", y = "Budget") +
      theme_minimal()
    
  ggplotly(p, tooltip = c("text", "x", "y"))
  
})

}

shinyApp(ui, server)

renv::status(
  
)
```
